complete_examples.text: Besides, the wheel–rail interaction is considered as rigid-elastic contact, the dynamic geometric relationship between the wheel and rail is determined by the track line method [34]; the normal contact force can be obtained by the nonlinear Hertz theory and creep force is calculated by the Shen–Hedrick–Elikins model [35], and moreover, the advanced matrix coupling method is performed to form the unified dynamic matrix of the TTBI system [32].
